answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents are assigned a unique identity tied to a stake, similar to a sparrow's nest being tied to its location. When an agent attempts to forge multiple identities, it must expend resources proportional to the number of identities created. This deters attackers, as the cost of creating numerous fake identities near a lagoon of honest agents outweighs potential benefits, making it economically infeasible to launch a Sybil attack.
